# GALPROP outputs and GALDEFs from Ackermann et al. 2012, ApJ 750, 3 ("Paper II")

Downloaded 2026-09-18 from https://galprop.stanford.edu/PaperIISuppMaterial/ .
Totani (arXiv:2507.07209, sec 2.3) adopts the parameter set SLZ6R30T150C2 from
this 128-model grid as his baseline diffuse model (Lorimer pulsar sources,
z_h = 6 kpc, R_h = 30 kpc, T_S = 150 K, E(B-V) cut 2 mag); his sec 3.4.4
variants are SS_Z6_R30_T150_C2 (SNR sources), SL_Z10_R30_T150_C2,
SL_Z6_R20_T150_C2, SL_Z6_R30_T100000_C2 (T_S = 1e5 K), SL_Z6_R30_T150_C5.
Archive naming: S{S,L,Y,O}_Z{4,6,8,10}_R{20,30}_T{150,100000}_C{2,5}.tar.
Files here: GALDEF.tar.gz (all 128 galdefs), SL_Z6_R30_T150_C2.tar. Gitignored.
